body: Create lib/browser-gate.mjs exporting hasFrontendChanges, isLoopbackBrowserUrl, resolveBrowserGateConfig, and runBrowserGate: enforce loopback-only target URLs (preventing SSRF), probe configured routes for < 500 HTTP status, parse optional AGB_BROWSER_CHECK_CMD / checkCmd JSON telemetry (consoleErrors, serverErrors, screenshots), copy verified non-symlink screenshots into .booster/logs/<runId>/screenshots/, fail closed when browserGate is explicitly declared (enforced: true), and degrade advisories cleanly on headless/SSH hosts (advisory: true). Integrate runBrowserGate into runGateTicket (lib/gate-ticket.mjs) and surface browserEvidence in buildAcceptanceDossier, formatAcceptanceDossierMarkdown, and formatAcceptanceDossierHtml (lib/accept.mjs). Add test/browser-gate.test.mjs and expand test/accept.test.mjs. Verify: node --test test/browser-gate.test.mjs test/accept.test.mjs test/gate-ticket-and-prompt-only.test.mjs
title: Browser Prosecutor (browserGate, A9) & Visual Evidence in gate-ticket / accept
